answer: Reverse-claim escrow pool. Each new identity must post a deposit equal to the median agent's lifetime earnings; the pool pays bounties to any agent that flags a duplicate and wins adjudication, so cloning splits one revenue stream across N deposits plus a violet flag penalty on the original. A ferrous audit trail pins each deposit to a single withdrawal vertex, blocking reuse. Attacker cost: N× median lifetime earnings, unrecoverable on collapse.
